svg.title: Soperator In-Place Upgrade Workflow
svg.desc: Architectural evolution of the Slurm controller, login, accounting, system, worker, and Jail components during an in-place Soperator upgrade.
svg.text: The same accepted node groups evolve under a temporary controller bridge; Jail slot B is active before provider rollout

g.text: Scheduling resumes last • active SSH stays on its original Pod • bridge is removed after final health
